purpose: We need to quantify the disease burden of chronic heart failure in Austria for the health technology assessment dossier of our late-stage compound.
question: How many adults have heart failure, by 10-year age band?
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Heart failure = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with I50.
Report per band: adults with heart failure.
